choice.basis: The chart's printed title is 'Selected High-Growth Quarters: Ad Spend vs Sales' (rec_03.O.1). The five plotted points (Q2 through Q6) form a strictly increasing, positive correlation from approximately (30, 68) to (70, 167) (rec_01.O.5, rec_02.O.1, rec_02.O.2). However, the title explicitly indicates the data is a 'Selected' subset (rec_03.O.1, rec_03.B.1), and the x-axis begins at 25 with no data points in the lower-left quadrant (rec_03.O.2, rec_03.O.4). This means the dashboard does not provide a baseline for quarters with lower spend or sales, making it impossible to determine overall average performance or the full impact of a 'broader' budget increase from this view alone (rec_03.B.2).
